title: Google OAuth client secret: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 4 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: GOCSP- (one letter short) vs GOCSPX-, prefix: GOCSPX with no hyphen before the body, and prefix: GOCSPX_ with an underscore vs GOCSPX- with a hyphen, and 1 more. Twin of "Google OAuth client secret: must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of google-oauth-client-secret-dotenv: prefix: GOCSPX with no hyphen before the body. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
